BackstoryDef.title: exceptional chapter serf
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a child of two serfs belonging to a space marine chapter, and was born into a life of service and toil for [PAWN_possessive] transhuman masters. The chapter's apothecaries noticed [PAWN_possessive] potential, however, and [PAWN_pronoun] was picked to undergo the process of induction as an aspirant.

BackstoryDef.title: space marine
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] underwent extensive testing as a Neophyte to a Space Marine chapter, and subsequently went through the lengthy process of surgery, genetic modification, and indoctrination to become a full-fledged Astartes. [PAWN_pronoun] is now a transhuman monster, one of the Angels of Death, entirely made for war.

BackstoryDef.title: space marine

BackstoryDef.title: techmarine
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted as a full battle brother of a Space Marine chapter and demonstrated a surprising affinity for machines. [PAWN_pronoun] was sent for extra training - both spiritual and practical - at a forge world of the Adeptus Mechanicus, and now serves as a bridge between the Cult of Mars and the Angels of Death.

BackstoryDef.title: apothecary
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted as a full battle brother of a Space Marine chapter and was subsequently trained in the rituals and skills of an Apothecary. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to perform battlefield medicine and oversee the recovery of wounded Astartes between battles, as well as extracting and taking care of fallen brothers' geneseed.

BackstoryDef.title: unknown
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Whatever [PAWN_pronoun] was before [PAWN_possessive] transformation matters not. [PAWN_nameDef] is a Custodian now.

BackstoryDef.title: Custodian
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was transformed into one of the Custodes, The Ten Thousand, the Watchers of the Throne, through an extensive process of gene modification, indoctrination and training. [PAWN_pronoun] is now the best of humanity, a warrior monk of fine sensibilities - or a terrifying inhuman monster to [PAWN_possessive] foes. [PAWN_nameDef] shows a particular inclination towards martial pursuits.

BackstoryDef.title: Custodian
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was transformed into one of the Custodes, The Ten Thousand, the Watchers of the Throne, through an extensive process of gene modification, indoctrination and training. [PAWN_pronoun] is now the best of humanity, a warrior monk of fine sensibilities - or a terrifying inhuman monster to [PAWN_possessive] foes. [PAWN_nameDef] shows a particular inclination towards peaceful pursuits, but is a peerless warrior when [PAWN_pronoun] needs to be.
